m.e: And if she knew something that cost her her life, well then, I intend to find out what it was.

m.e: I will ask her and see how she feels.

m.e: I thought I'd see how you were doing.

m.t: Ale za tři hodiny a dvacet šest minut to zjistím.
m.e: But I have three hours and 26 minutes to figure it out.

m.e: If there comes a day I found out you betrayed me. What do you want me to do?

m.e: And then I find out our family has a history, after all.

m.e: And apparently... that's the way I'm gonna find what's missing.

m.t: Možná zjistím více informací na setkání Rady starších příští týden.
m.e: I should get more details at the Council of Elders meeting next week.

m.t: Jestli jí jedna mých děvčat má, rychle to zjistím.
m.e: If one of these girls got it, I find it quick.

m.t: Jdu si promluvit s dalšími kontakty, uvidíme, co zjistím.
m.e: I'm going to talk to some of my other contacts, see what else I can find for you.

m.t: Jestli něco zjistím, chcete, abych vám zavolala?
m.e: If I find anything, do you want me to call you?

m.t: Dám vám vědět, až zjistím něco víc.
m.e: I will, let you know as soon as I have more information.

m.t: Zjistím, o co vám jde a jak to se senátorkou souvisí.
m.e: Instead, I'm gonna figure out what you're up to and how it connects to the senator.

m.t: Jednou zjistím, kdo jsou moji skuteční rodiče.

m.e: I have no desire to see you, but it's my job to report to you what I find about your cases.

m.t: O mrtvých leccos vím a zjistím to.
m.e: I know things about the dead.

m.e: I'm gonna find out what's up with it.

m.e: I'll keep you posted if I find out.

m.e: You knew what I'd find, didn't you?

m.e: - I have yet to find out, but I shall find out.

m.e: Yeah, I'll see what my guy can do, and I'll call you later, okay?

m.t: Zjistím, co se dnes stalo.
m.e: I'm gonna find out what happened today.

m.t: - Jednou zjistím, kdo to udělal.
m.e: Once I know who did it.

m.t: - To zjistím, až to uvidím.
m.e: I'll know when I see it.

m.t: Zjistím, jestli moje funguje.
m.e: I'll just see if mine works.

m.t: Zjistím to pro tebe.
m.e: I'll find out for you.

m.t: Nevím, ale zjistím to.
m.e: I don't know but I'm going to find out.

m.e: Let me find out why she's here.

m.t: Teď se pro změnu třeba budeš moct soustředit na sebe.
m.e: Thanks. Maybe now you'll even have time. To focus on yourself for a change.

m.e: Look, when I said I wanted a change, I think you've misunderstood me.

m.t: Za zázraky se musíme modlit, pro změnu musíme pracovat.
m.e: We must pray for miracles, work for change.

m.e: Oh, it's kind of fun treating adults for a change.

m.t: Pojďme se pro změnu projít.

m.t: Připravte se na změnu.

m.e: But please don't tell me we're here to kidnap Raphael's grandmother.

m.e: I'm saying I'm for intervention into Troy.

m.e: We're just here to help you.

m.t: Nešli jsme až sem, abysme to vzdali.
m.e: We sure didn't come this far to give up now.

m.e: But if he made it that long, maybe he knows enough to piece together a plan.

m.e: And what do you want us to do exactly?

m.e: The key... the key to being four million dollars richer.

m.e: Just so we couldn't go to the party.

m.e: She wants us to let it be.

m.e: She will not let us leave this place alive.

m.t: To abysme podpálili celej les.
m.e: Well, we better burn the whole fucking forest.

m.t: - On chtěl, abysme to stihli.
m.e: Well, he wanted us to make it.

m.e: To start our new life.

m.e: He wants us to pursue him.

m.e: And the one thing she's always wished is to be able to know her real dad.

m.e: I just wish I could be there to see his face when he finds out what you really are.

m.t: Jen bych si přála, aby to byl sport, který bych milovala.
m.e: I just wish there was, like, a sport that I loved.

m.e: Do you ever wish you were the person you used to be?

m.t: Jen jsem si přála, abych věděl ... proč.
m.e: I just wish I knew... why.

m.t: To, co sis přála od prvního dne.

m.e: I wish you'd meet that jerk just once.

m.t: Tak moc jsem si ji přála.

m.e: You want to talk to someone?

m.t: JE, kým by sis přála být.
m.e: Is who you wish to be.

m.e: It's what I've always wanted.

m.t: - Přála bych si něco podobného.
m.e: - Wish I had something like it.

m.e: I wish you didn't have to leave so soon.

m.e: I'm sorry this wasn't the ending you wanted.

m.e: Oh, honey, all I've ever wanted was for you to be okay.

m.t: Přála bych si, abys to tu mohl vidět.
m.e: I wish you could see this place.

m.e: I just wish you weren't still here.

m.e: You wished that she could have a chance for a happy ending.

m.e: I wish we didn't have to have this conversation.

m.e: What do you want me to do?

m.e: I wished the Evil Queen away so I can be free of everything she did.
